fields.name: source port
fields.description: the port of the sending process.

fields.name: length
fields.description: the length in octets of this user datagram including this header and the data.

fields.name: checksum
fields.presence condition: if (checksum == 0) then transmitted as all ones
fields.description: the 16-bit one's complement of the one's complement sum of a pseudo header.
constraints: if the computed checksum is zero, it is transmitted as all ones.

parsing context.name: ip pseudo header
parsing context.description: the pseudo header contains the source address, destination address, protocol, and udp length.
